_comment: CliniX media registry AND licence gate. Nothing renders unless cleared === true with a real licence and attribution. This mirrors atlas-pipeline/sources.json require_clear(): the registry REFUSES uncleared media rather than documenting the problem in a comment. Contrast assets/kardiox-learn/, which holds 872 images with no manifest and no licence record at all.
_howToClear: SELF-AUTHORED (diagram/animation): set inline:true + diagramId, licence 'StewardMD original', attribution 'StewardMD'.
SYNTHESIZED audio: set synth:true + audioKind. It is generated, so there is no source to credit, but the UI must call it synthesized.

EMBED: verify with `curl 'https://www.youtube.com/oembed?url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<ID>&format=json'`. HTTP 200 means public AND embeddable. Take attribution from author_name and title from title. Anything other than 200 must stay cleared:false.
HOSTED FILE: only for media that is openly licensed (CC0/CC BY/public domain) or owner-produced. Record licence, attribution and sourceUrl.
NEVER download, re-host, or strip attribution from third-party media. NEVER set cleared:true to make a screen look finished.
_status: Three media classes, all legally clean. (1) SELF-AUTHORED inline SVG diagrams and animations - we drew them, so they always clear. (2) SYNTHESIZED audio generated by Web Audio at play time - a teaching model of a sound, not a recording, with no rights holder, labelled as synthesized wherever it plays. (3) EMBEDDED YouTube via the official player - never downloaded, never re-hosted; embeddable:true is set ONLY after the YouTube oEmbed endpoint returned 200 for that video, which is the rights holder's own embedding switch, and the attribution is the channel name from that same response.

practicals:obg.drug.conjugated-estrogens.caption: Medical diagram shows estrogen receptor activation across bone, liver, and reproductive tissues

practicals:obg.drug.danazol.caption: Medical diagram shows gonadotropin inhibition and atrophy of ectopic endometrial tissue
practicals:obg.drug.danazol.alt: Illustration shows danazol inhibiting hypothalamic-pituitary gonadotropin secretion and binding androgen receptors to induce atrophy and regression of endometriotic implants.

practicals:obg.drug.folic-acid.caption: Medical illustration shows folate one-carbon metabolism supporting embryonic neural tube closure
practicals:obg.drug.folic-acid.alt: Diagram depicts enzymatic conversion of folic acid into active tetrahydrofolate metabolites driving thymidylate synthesis, DNA methylation, and primary embryonic neural tube closure.

practicals:obg.drug.gestrinone.caption: Medical illustration shows gonadotropin suppression and regression of ectopic endometrium
practicals:obg.drug.gestrinone.alt: Diagram illustrates gestrinone binding progesterone and androgen receptors to suppress ovarian folliculogenesis and induce atrophy of ectopic endometriosis lesions.

practicals:obg.drug.gnrh-agonists.caption: Medical illustration shows gonadotropin flare followed by receptor downregulation in the pituitary
practicals:obg.drug.gnrh-agonists.alt: Diagram demonstrates continuous GnRH agonist stimulation causing initial LH and FSH release followed by pituitary GnRH receptor downregulation, producing profound ovarian estrogen suppression.

practicals:obg.drug.hmg.alt: Diagram depicts the two-cell gonadotropin model with LH acting on theca cells to produce androstenedione and FSH stimulating granulosa cell aromatase to synthesize estradiol.

practicals:obg.drug.labetalol.caption: Medical illustration shows concurrent alpha-1 and beta-adrenergic blockade reducing vascular resistance
practicals:obg.drug.labetalol.alt: Illustration depicts labetalol competitively blocking alpha-1 receptors to cause systemic vasodilation while blocking beta-1 receptors to prevent reflex tachycardia in gestational hypertension.

practicals:obg.drug.methotrexate.caption: Medical illustration shows dihydrofolate reductase blockade suppressing trophoblast DNA synthesis

practicals:obg.drug.methyldopa.alt: Diagram depicts enzymatic conversion of alpha-methyldopa to alpha-methylnoradrenaline in central adrenergic neurons, stimulating alpha-2 receptors and decreasing peripheral sympathetic tone.

practicals:obg.drug.methylergometrine.caption: Medical illustration shows serotonergic and adrenergic activation causing tetanic uterine contraction
practicals:obg.drug.methylergometrine.alt: Illustration depicts methylergometrine stimulating myometrial 5-HT2 and alpha-adrenergic receptors, inducing sustained tonic uterine contraction to control postpartum haemorrhage while causing peripheral vasoconstriction.

practicals:obg.drug.misoprostol.caption: Medical illustration shows EP receptor stimulation for cervical ripening and myometrial contraction
practicals:obg.drug.misoprostol.alt: Diagram illustrates misoprostol activating EP prostanoid receptors to cause cervical collagen remodelling, myometrial smooth muscle contractions in labour induction, and protective gastric mucosal secretion.

practicals:obg.drug.nitroglycerine.caption: Medical illustration shows nitric oxide generating cGMP to relax vascular myocytes

practicals:obg.drug.ormeloxifene.caption: Medical illustration shows endometrial estrogen antagonism preventing blastocyst implantation and bleeding

practicals:obg.drug.tibolone.caption: Medical illustration shows tissue-selective estrogenic, progestogenic, and androgenic actions of metabolites

practicals:obg.drug.tranexamic-acid.caption: Medical illustration shows plasminogen lysine-binding blockade preventing fibrin clot lysis

practicals:obg.drug.valethamate-bromide.caption: Medical illustration shows muscarinic antagonism relaxing cervical smooth muscle during labour

practicals:paed.drug.carbamazepine.caption: Medical illustration shows voltage-gated sodium channel inhibition and hepatic microsomal auto-induction

practicals:paed.drug.cefixime.caption: Medical illustration shows penicillin-binding protein inhibition disrupting bacterial peptidoglycan cell wall

practicals:paed.drug.domperidone.caption: Medical illustration shows peripheral D2 antagonism at the area postrema and gut

practicals:paed.drug.emergency-arrest.caption: Medical illustration shows receptor targets and dosing algorithms for paediatric cardiac resuscitation
